envelope.description: Error fields, failure data and the Vibe wording

body.title: Error fields, failure data and the Vibe wording
body.summary: Add HandlingBudgetError with the 'input-does-not-fit' reason and the optional upstream and partFailures fields (with FailureCause) to ShaperAnswerStepFailedError; add failureData with the bounded JSON-safe cause builder; add 'vibe exited with' to CLI_FAILURE_TEXTS; add handling and answerStepReason to LookupFailedError; add the optional data field to TaskExecutionRecord.
acceptanceChecks: failureData gives the typed and plain shapes, nests a cause at most 3 levels, records a non-Error cause as a string and survives JSON.stringify and parse
isModelCallFailure recognises a Vibe non-zero exit with and without the retry prefix, not inside quoted text, and still not a size refusal or a schema-invalid reply
the added error and record fields are optional and existing callers compile unchanged

tests.name: failure-data.test.ts: typed and plain shapes, 3-level cause bound, non-Error cause as string, JSON round trip, upstream and partFailures kept in order
model-failure.test.ts: isModelCallFailure recognises 'vibe exited with' with and without the retry prefix, not in quoted text, and excludes size refusals and schema-invalid replies
failure-contract.test.ts: RunFailure shape and code 'executor-aggregator-failed' unchanged; TaskExecutionRecord, LookupFailedError and ShaperAnswerStepFailedError gain only optional JSON-safe fields
